name: auth-proof
description: Cross-language proof of the locked auth construction (SPEC section 4): mac = HMAC-SHA256(key = SHA-256(raw token bytes), message = nonce bytes), lowercase hex. Token bytes are 0x00..0x1f, nonce bytes are 0xa0..0xbf. expect.macHex was computed by an independent third implementation (.NET System.Security.Cryptography: SHA256.ComputeHash for the key, HMACSHA256.ComputeHash over the nonce) — NOT by either codec. Both the Rust and Dart auth-proof helpers must reproduce it byte-identically. Special fixture format documented in fixtures README.
